mapper.update: UPDATE mq_outbox_event SET status = 'FAILED', next_retry_at = NULL, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE aggregate_type = #{aggregateType} AND aggregate_id = #{aggregateId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING') AND sent_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mq_outbox_event WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND retry_count < max_retry_count AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE mq_outbox_event SET status = 'SENDING', locked_by = #{lockedBy}, locked_at = #{lockedAt}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{lockedAt} WHERE id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND retry_count < max_retry_count AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{lockedAt})

UPDATE mq_outbox_event SET status = 'SENT', next_retry_at = NULL, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, sent_at = #{sentAt}, last_error = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{sentAt} WHERE id = #{eventId} AND status = 'SENDING' AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE mq_outbox_event SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, sent_at = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{eventId} AND status = 'SENDING' AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND #{retryCount} <= max_retry_count

UPDATE mq_outbox_event SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = NULL, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, sent_at = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{eventId} AND status = 'SENDING' AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND #{retryCount} <= max_retry_count

UPDATE mq_outbox_event SET status = 'PENDING', next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE status = 'SENDING' AND locked_at IS NOT NULL AND locked_at < #{lockExpiredBefore} AND retry_count < max_retry_count
